title: Oxva Nexlim V2 Series Replacement Vape Pods
description: Maintain optimal performance in your OXVA Nexlim or Nexlim GO device with these official V2 replacement pods. Designed for everyday reliability, these 2ml capacity cartridges feature a super-practical top-fill system, allowing you to replenish your e-liquid cleanly and efficiently without removing the pod from your device. To provide complete peace of mind, OXVA has engineered these pods with a robust 5-layer leak-proof structure to prevent unwanted spills and condensation. At the core of the Nexlim V2 pods is OXVA’s next-generation dual mesh coil technology. Powered by the advanced Unitech 2.0 system, these integrated coils heat your e-liquid with remarkable consistency, delivering exceptionally accurate flavour and smooth atomisation. Built for endurance, OXVA states that these durable coils can provide up to 15 refills* before a replacement is required, making them a highly cost-effective choice for daily vaping. To cater to your specific preferences, the pods are available in three distinct resistances. The 0.6ohm option (20W to 40W) is perfect for a restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) draw with increased vapour production. Alternatively, the 0.8ohm (12W to 32W) and 1.2ohm (10W to 25W) options are specifically tailored for a traditional mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience, working flawlessly with standard 50/50 and nicotine salt e-liquids. Each pack contains three replacement pods. *Refill lifespan is an estimate provided by the manufacturer and will vary depending on your usage habits and chosen e-liquid. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
